reason: the run was recorded before portfolio series were captured; its equity_bps is a running sum of per-trade bps, not an account
cost_basis: headline: the ledger's cost_bps (flat-round-trip-bps, 24 bps round trip); alternate: modeled_cost_bps (statutory charges plus slippage)

session_counts.recorded_days_meaning: distinct entry sessions: the record groups each trade's whole result on the session it opened

portfolio.method: fixed-notional book marked to market at each session close (signal_engine.backtest.book_series); profits are not reinvested
